root_idea.summary: The root has two related orientations: becoming prominent or visible, and a strong elevated structure serving as a refuge or enclosure.
root_idea.development: From prominence and visibility develop the eye-quality of wide, clear eyes, conspicuous beauty, and the display of adornment; from strong elevated structures develop towers and the celestial برج as a prominent heavenly station.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the singular dictionary citation form بُرْجٌ.
Displayed under the singular active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: To display one's adornment or bodily beauty conspicuously.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, of women displaying adornment or beauty before men or strangers; display to a husband is not included in the culpable use described in the lexical evidence.

senses.definition: To emerge or appear from one's tower or dwelling.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the Quranic construction in 33:33 understands the verb in this sense rather than as display of adornment.

senses.definition: A tower or fortified, castle-like structure.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic plural, especially in 4:78, the word can denote earthly fortified towers or structures; that passage is also given a celestial or figurative interpretation.

senses.definition: A prominent heavenly station or structure, such as a constellation, asterism, or lunar mansion.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural refers to the برج of the heaven in 15:16, 25:61, and 85:1. Classical interpretation includes constellations or great stars, lunar mansions, and, alternatively, gates of heaven or celestial pavilions.

senses.definition: Displaying adornment or bodily beauty conspicuously.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is a feminine plural active participle referring to women who display adornment; the construction in 24:60 concerns displaying زِينَةٌ, or adornment.

senses.definition: The act or condition of displaying adornment or bodily beauty conspicuously.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction in 33:33 describes public display associated with the former جاهلية practice.

senses.definition: Emergence or appearance from one's tower or dwelling.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the verbal noun in 33:33 understands it as appearance from a برج rather than display of adornment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become apparent, manifest, conspicuous, and elevated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use combining visibility with height or elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To possess the eye-quality called بَرَجٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The quality is described as a wide, open, clear, and beautiful eye in which the white surrounds the black.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a person's state or condition to become ample in respect of eating and drinking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form I use concerning the condition or circumstances of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To build a tower or similar elevated structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV, with a tower or برج as the object built.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pigeon-turret or pigeon-house, serving as a lodging place for pigeons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized architectural use of the singular noun.
Presented as a primary signification associated with the root and underlying the comparative use أَبْرَجُ, “stronger.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wide, open, clear, and beautiful appearance of the eye, including the condition in which the white entirely surrounds the black; also the spacing between the eyebrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily description with several closely related specifications of eye breadth, whiteness, blackness, and beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beauty, elegance, or prettiness; a shining, splendid, conspicuous, or well-known quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of conspicuous beauty or excellence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large, broad, or liberal disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of breadth or liberality of character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person having the eye-quality بَرَجٌ; also an eye possessing that quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form بَرْجَاءُ is applied to a woman or to an eye with the same quality.
A comparative use expressing greater strength.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel or receptacle, generally a skin, used to churn milk or extract its butter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized utensil synonymous with مِمْخَضَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment decorated with figures resembling towers, or with eye-like designs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description may refer to figures of towers or similar architectural forms, or to patterned eyes.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I possession of the eye-quality بَرَجٌ.
Ample condition in eating and drinking.
Form V display of adornment and beauty; Quran-attested branch.
Tower, pigeon-turret, and stated primary strength branch.
Celestial برج and its Quranic interpretive range.
Eye quality and related bodily description.
Adjective for a person or eye with the برج quality.
Garment decorated with tower-like or eye-like figures.

cautions: The celestial Quranic برج has a shared lexical branch but varied interpretations, including constellations, lunar mansions, stars or asterisms, gates of heaven, and celestial pavilions.
For تَبَرَّجَ and تَبَرُّجٌ, emergence from one's برج is preserved as an alternative Quranic interpretation rather than treated as the ordinary display-of-adornment sense.
